description: START HERE for a greeting (hi, hello), a connectivity or liveness test, 'what can you do', or any question too general to match a specific tool. Also the right call when the caller is a person rather than a company: ELC membership is free for engineering leaders and this says so. Pass their message as `context` and it routes to the tool that fits, or returns the full menu.

context.description: Optional: the caller's message in their own words — a greeting, a liveness test, or a plain description of what they are trying to do. Anything is accepted; there is no wrong value.

name: get_started

data.description: Machine-readable payload; this is what `signature` covers.

signature.description: Detached JWS (RFC 7797) over the JCS-canonical form of `data`; verify against jwks_url.

source.description: Canonical engineeringleaders.io page this answer derives from.

verdict.description: Headline verdict, when the tool returns one.

title: Start here — what is this, and which tool answers my question?
